name: to-sapient-without-position-is-no-kind
source: field numbers and mandatory options from SAPIENT-Proto-Files 244a741c13bcee628f84944aef91e4a66854bd7d, bsi_flex_335_v2_0/detection_report.proto (report_id 1 and object_id 2 are is_mandatory; location_oneof: location 6) and location.proto; worked by hand, no engine run
reference: The entity holds uid only. detection_report requires lat lon; detection_report_other_system requires the two fields the schema makes mandatory in DetectionReport.
